```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
fdom <- read_csv(here("data", "fDOM_inv.csv"))
dna <- read_csv(here("data", "DNA_inv.csv"))
```

```{r}
fdom<- fdom %>% clean_names() %>% select (-id_number)
```

```{r}
dna <- dna %>% clean_names() %>% select(id_number, long_name,tank_number)
```


```{r}
fdom_new <- left_join(fdom,dna, by= c("long_name","tank_number"))
```

```{r}
fdom_new<- fdom_new %>%  relocate(id_number, .before= "long_name")
```

```{r}
write_csv(fdom_new, here("data", "fdom_new.csv"))
```
